description: Defines a SwiftUI View component 'ContextUsageBar' for visualizing context token usage with customizable colors and accessibility features.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a horizontal bar indicating the proportion of used tokens within a context, with dynamic coloring based on usage percentage.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of used tokens, clamped between 0 and 1.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the percentage of tokens used, or nil if unknown.

methods.name: tint
methods.description: Determines the color of the usage bar based on the usage percentage.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides a textual description of usage percentage for accessibility.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the SwiftUI view hierarchy for the usage bar.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Builds the visual representation of the usage bar with color fill and stroke.
